name: Cable Shot
author: Community
description: A TV directory for the channels bundled in this plugin: what is on now, what is up next, and a real TV guide in the player.

warning.title: Before you install
text: Cable Shot plays live TV streams from web addresses that were bundled into it by its developer. PEK TV did not review these channels, and the stream servers can see your internet address.
Only watch channels you have the right to watch. Streams may be unavailable, out of date, or blocked in your country. You are responsible for what you watch.
